facts.anchor: Every single thing in her and Elora’s home had been carefully turned upside down.
Tannenfell is everything we’d ever hoped it would be.
Even though things are wonderful, there is definitely a cloud of fear that hangs over the vampires.
It’s true what Shella said. Every so often, someone does disappear. One just in the time I’ve been here. A woman named Taznel.
Speaking of bringing them down, they found that woman’s body yesterday. Taznel.
They—they closed the borders. They can’t come home.
“I think I know who did it.”
